detail.longDescription: When I shut down LINUXexpert.org I figured nobody would miss the study guides. The mail said otherwise. So they're back at linuxexpert.net, updated and current: 20 guides, mostly Linux Foundation and CNCF, plus practice exams that run like the real thing. Real length, a clock you can't pause, fresh questions every sitting, accurate domain weights. Lab exams and RHCSA are on the way.
